description:
Proposals newest first, with phase, tally and the inscription each points at.

Phases: `pending` (filed, voting not open yet), `voting`, `concludable`, `passed`/`failed` (settled), `expired` (nobody concluded in time; can no longer pay).

Reads only.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

era.description: Which legion deployment to read: 1 (live, default). Proposal ids restart at 1 each era, so an id alone is ambiguous.

limit.description: How many proposals to scan back from the newest (default 10)

phase.description: Filter by phase. 'live' means pending+voting+concludable. Default: all

name: legion_list_stories
